## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and any limitations. Add a regression test for behavior changes.

- [ ] Relevant tests and type checks pass.
- [ ] User-facing docs are updated where needed.
- [ ] The title reads as a release-note line and the category label is correct
      (see [release notes](https://github.com/Epsirom/braid/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#release-notes)).
- [ ] Breaking changes, if any, include migration guidance in the docs.
- [ ] For release PRs: `.github/upgrade-notes.md` lists what users must do to upgrade.
